tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Dori expressing desire-1, using only the supplied approved neutral as the reference for character identity, skin, hair, eyes, costume, colors, rendering and compact childlike proportions. Act the emotion with a genuinely different body pose: wholesome eager anticipation of a favorite treat or adventure, a hopeful smile, a little forward lean and hands held separately near her chest. Keep the acting age-appropriate and non-suggestive. Both eyes visibly open, retain original colored iris outlines, shading and visible colored border; place one solid pale amber-gold heart-shaped pupil centered within each iris. Hearts are pupils, not highlights or floating symbols. Simple readable natural hands near the torso, coherent anatomy with one thumb and four fingers per hand where visible, exactly two legs and feet in an uncomplicated stance. Keep the entire silhouette including hair, accessories, hands and shoes in frame, roughly 2–4% top and bottom padding. Transparent background, no scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects or baked shadow.
